text: Retained AttemptEpoch and RetrySafety because P6f.24 made them production-reachable: managed retry authorization advances epochs, stale epochs are fenced, and retry safety is persisted through requests, invocations, handles, codecs, and policy. Removed LocalProcessRunner and RunningCommand because they had no implementation or consumer; Fs2CommandExecutor remains the supported local process interpreter. Removed unused SSH and managed testkit test-to-compile edges while retaining local testkit use.
